title: GHA: Update dependency ngtcp2/ngtcp2 to v1.19.0
body:
This PR contains the following updates:

| Package | Update | Change |
|---|---|---|
| [ngtcp2/ngtcp2](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2) | minor | `1.18.0` -> `1.19.0` |

---

### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>ngtcp2/ngtcp2 (ngtcp2/ngtcp2)</summary>

### [`v1.19.0`](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/releases/tag/v1.19.0): ngtcp2 v1.19.0

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/compare/v1.18.0...v1.19.0)

#### What's Changed

- Gha ubuntu arm by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1925](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1925)
- examples: Generate lowcase\_tbl and remove redundant cast by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1927](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1927)
- build(deps): bump actions/checkout from 5 to 6 by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [#​1926](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1926)
- ngtcp2\_log: Add missing error codes by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1928](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1928)
- ngtcp2\_str: Remove redundant assignment by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1929](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1929)
- Update RTT when the largest packet number is acked by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1930](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1930)
- ngtcp2\_qlog: Add const qualifier to vec\_pkt\_type\* by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1932](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1932)
- bbr: Remove CWND reduction on congestion event by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1933](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1933)
- GHA: Specify ubuntu-arm in include by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1934](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1934)
- bbr: More backups for spurious losses by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1935](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1935)
- GHA: Simplify build matrix with includes by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1936](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1936)
- GHA: Simplify matrix with array of objects by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1937](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1937)
- examples: Allow 5% margin for the expected goodput by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1938](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1938)
- examples: Compute goodput in double by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1939](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1939)
- Add ngtcp2\_vec\_drop by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1940](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1940)
- Rewrite get\_uvarint by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1942](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1942)
- Rework ngtcp2\_frame union to avoid potential UB by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1943](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1943)
- ksl: Rework key storage to avoid struct hack by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1944](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1944)
- acktr: Refactor ACK creation function by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1945](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1945)
- examples: Replace in\_addr\_union with std::variant by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1946](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1946)
- examples: Replace sockaddr\_union with std::variant by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1948](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1948)
- examples: Show error regardless of config.quiet by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1949](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1949)
- examples: Add as\_ngtcp2\_addr helper function by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1950](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1950)
- examples: Fix linker error in examplestest by adding shared.cc dependency by [@​devkdas](https://redirect.github.com/devkdas) in [#​1952](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1952)
- examples: Make initialization form compact by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1953](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1953)
- examples: Add \[\[nodiscard]] to Address functions by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1954](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1954)
- examples: Modernize field initializers by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1955](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1955)
- ngtcp2\_ksl: Remove alignment enforcement for keys by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1956](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1956)
- Bump urlparse by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1957](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1957)
- examples: Adopt nghttp3\_recv\_settings2 by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1958](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1958)
- fuzz: Add begin\_path\_validation to read\_write\_pkt by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1959](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1959)
- Refactor with compound literals by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1960](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1960)
- Add libngtcp2 to pkg-config Requires.private by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1964](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1964)
- Revise libngtcp2 include dir setup by [@​dg0yt](https://redirect.github.com/dg0yt) in [#​1962](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1962)
- build(deps): bump actions/upload-artifact from 5 to 6 by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [#​1967](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1967)
- build(deps): bump actions/download-artifact from 6 to 7 by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [#​1969](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1969)
- build(deps): bump actions/cache from 4 to 5 by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [#​1968](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1968)
- Include array in siphash example by [@​targos](https://redirect.github.com/targos) in [#​1970](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1970)
- Export CMake target for ngtcp2\_crypto\_ossl(\_static) by [@​dg0yt](https://redirect.github.com/dg0yt) in [#​1963](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1963)
- Bump boringssl by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1971](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1971)
- Bump aws-lc by [@​tatsuhiro-t](https://redirect.github.com/tatsuhiro-t) in [#​1972](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1972)

#### New Contributors

- [@​dg0yt](https://redirect.github.com/dg0yt) made their first contribution in [#​1962](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1962)
- [@​targos](https://redirect.github.com/targos) made their first contribution in [#​1970](https://redirect.github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/pull/1970)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/ngtcp2/ngtcp2/compare/v1.18.0...v1.19.0>

</details>
